description: This Java class provides utility methods for date calculations within a book project, including methods to get the current week number, calculate weeks remaining in the year, and check if a date is in the current year or in the future. It also includes an internal utility class for obtaining the current date and time.

classes.name: DateUtils
classes.description: A utility class for date-related calculations such as finding current week number, weeks left in the year, and date comparisons.

classes.name: TimeUtils
classes.description: A nested static class providing methods to obtain current date and time, and week fields, used internally by DateUtils.

methods.name: getCurrentWeekNumberOfYear
methods.description: Returns the current week number of the year based on the current date and locale.

methods.name: calculateWeeksLeftInYearFromCurrentWeek
methods.description: Calculates the number of weeks remaining in the year given the current week number.

methods.name: dateIsInCurrentYear
methods.description: Checks if a given date falls within the current year.

methods.name: isDateInFuture
methods.description: Checks if a given date is after the current date.
